title: Release cadence calibration: RC quarantine windows, staggered hold lanes, and automated notes extractor
creator: Ava Patel
description: Introduce a coordinated mechanism to quarantine candidate release bundles (RCs) in short-lived hold windows, run staged validation across canary cohorts, and produce distilled release notes automatically. Goals: reduce noisy rollbacks, shorten decision latency for promotion to stable channels, and create structured release artifacts suitable for Console and release feeds.
acceptance_criteria: 1) RCs can be assigned a quarantine window tag and routed to dedicated canary cohorts via scheduler. 2) For 3 consecutive weekly candidates, mean canary error rate must be captured and available as a single metric in the release dashboard. 3) Automated notes extractor produces a summary (features/bugfix/security/migration) for each RC within 30 minutes of quarantine close. 4) Promotion to LTS lane must fail if canary regression > 0.5% or if any critical regression detected. 5) Rollback fencing triggers an automated freeze on downstream DB migrations when a rollback is initiated.
technical_notes: Design a short-lived label 'quarantine:<YYYYMMDD>-<window>' applied at RC tagging. The scheduler will route traffic split 5/15/80 across shadow, warm-canary, and live-canary pools. Implement lightweight fingerprinting: a deterministic hash of commit list + build artifacts to identify RC identity even if tags are re-created. Notes extractor will ingest commit messages, linked PR labels, and CI test summaries, apply simple heuristics and templates, and output JSON summary consumed by console endpoints. Store quarantine metrics in metrics namespace 'release.quarantine.*' with rollup keys by rc_fingerprint and week.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks): implement quarantine tag + scheduler routing, small group internal canaries only. Phase 2 (2 weeks): add fingerprinting and metrics rollups; wire metrics to dashboard. Phase 3 (2 weeks): deploy notes extractor, wire into release automation to attach to RC metadata. Phase 4: enable rollback fencing and cross-team notifications; run 3 dry-run rehearsals with platform and infra teams.
test_plan: Create synthetic RCs that introduce controlled regressions (error-rate bump, latency spike). Validate that quarantine metrics reflect anomalies within 10 minutes. Verify notes extractor grouping maps labeled PRs correctly (>= 95% precision on feature vs bug classification in evaluation set). Test rollback fencing by simulating rollback event and ensuring DB migration gates remain closed until manual unblock.
decisions: 1) Use deterministic commit-list hashing (SHA256 over canonicalized commit set) for RC fingerprinting. 2) Notes extraction will be rule-based initially; evaluate ML-based entity classification in Q3. 3) Canary split pattern chosen as 5/15/80 to prioritize fast signal while minimizing blast radius.

next_steps: 1) Kick off scheduler implementation spike and add code owners. 2) Provision canary pools in staging with required telemetry. 3) Build initial notes extractor ruleset and run against last 12 RCs for precision/recall evaluation. 4) Schedule cross-team rehearsal on 2026-03-24.
notes: Early feedback from PM and Console teams: ensure notes output maps to Console sections (Summary, Risk, Migration). Platform SRE requested a kill-switch to opt out of automatic promotions per-customer. Budget note: expect ~2 engineer-weeks of infra provisioning effort.
